Suite: 832 tests, one failure on arrival -- DECISIONS-SCREENING-15.md was on disk but named in none of the three decision-file lists. Repaired in paths.py, reconcile.py and tests/test_decision_files.py; the decision-file tests are 27/27 green after. This is the split-file bookkeeping gate earning its keep an eighth time, and the first time the file appeared before the lists did (paths.py had it, reconcile.py did not, so the failure named the wrong list).

Neither the HN API (0 of 60) nor the GitHub issues API (0 of 8) returns an arrival field; Stack Exchange returns a positive view_count on 80 of 80. E069's CONFIRMED verdict is withdrawn; the need-harvest retirement is not reopened.

E065's detector, unmodified, on 36 real modern bank exports (34231 transactions, 29 public repos, 2021-2026): recall 0.394, F1 0.160. G1 (recall >= 0.50) and G2 (F1 margin over Actual Budget findSchedules >= +0.05, observed +0.0098) did not fire. G3 permutation 0.0000, G4 and G5 fired. 6 of 20 misses are the merchant axis the action went in to measure; 14 are the amount-CV gate rejecting a price change.

D090 a detector's errors are attributed to a cause before any rate is compared, a mechanism is closed on the population that breaks it rather than the one that confirmed it, and a precision figure computed against a positives-only label set is not a precision figure

E072 corpus: 36 real bank exports / 34231 transactions, selected mechanically from 411 candidate CSVs found by GitHub code search over real merchant strings. Nine selection and labelling defects were found and repaired during the build, all recorded in the experiment's own code. Three are worth carrying forward: (1) a loader that silently read a budget app's already-cleaned Payee column instead of the raw bank Description beside it -- and that same file produced the best-looking under-grouping numbers before the fix, so the defect inflated the finding it invalidated; (2) two privacy screens written and BOTH withdrawn, the first because it fired on 'Kroger Pharmacy' and deleted 30 of 43 accounts, the second because it fired on 'SAN BERNARDIN CA' -- the control that replaced them (bytes never committed; test_no_descriptor_leaks.py asserts no name or long digit run reaches a tracked file) does not need to recognise a name; (3) the allocator now reports F185 rather than F102, because F101's own write-up names F184 in prose and the allocator counts any numbered cell, so D089 rule 3 cost 83 numbers.

Precision reported twice, on purpose: watchlist-scored 0.100 against a hand-read stratified sample of 0.91 over the same detections. The watchlist holds 33 recurring-payment families and cannot cover accounts whose readers hold mortgages and meal plans, so it is positives-only. Both numbers are in results.json. E065's headline precision of 1.0000 was measured the same way and survives only because its synthetic corpus contained no unclaimed groups.

data.next: Replace the CV ceiling with a piecewise-constant price model and measure it on E072's frozen corpus, with detect.py frozen as the baseline arm and a predeclared G1 recall >= 0.50, G2 unchanged. Evidence that it is a specification defect rather than a threshold to tune: a24's ChatGPT is 9 x 0.00, CV 0.000, interval regularity 0.922 and is detected today, while the identical mechanism with one price step is missed in four accounts. A pass closes the detector, not the domain: F185 closes one implementation on 36 public exports, and whether a person pays for this is open because Actual already ships the feature and E072's actual_raw 0.150 is a floor.
data.summary: Landed the six unlanded 2026-10-08 sessions and E067-E070; ran E071 (neither the HN API, 0 of 60, nor the GitHub issues API, 0 of 8, returns any arrival field, while Stack Exchange returns a positive view_count on 80 of 80 - F101, D088, and E069's CONFIRMED is withdrawn) and E072 (E065's recurring-expense detector unmodified on 36 real modern bank exports, 34231 transactions, 29 public repositories, 2021-2026: recall 0.394, F1 0.160, G1 and G2 did not fire - F185, D090). E072's failure was not the merchant-name axis E066 named: it is worth 6 of 20 misses, while 14 come from an amount-CV ceiling nobody had questioned, so one price change makes a subscription invisible. Two reading results: Actual Budget's shipped findSchedules() scores F1 0.150 against E065's 0.160, so the engines are within noise and the merchant axis is the mechanism; and precision reads 0.100 against a positives-only watchlist where a hand-read stratified sample reads 0.91 on the same detections.
